g.title: j2791821249
g.text: And here we are, twiddling our thumbs. Either you truly have nothing better to do, Usurper, or you have all that you want from me. Which is it?

g.title: j3788948842->j2791821249
g.text: RoatheFailUltimate

g.title: j617454213
g.text: Evaluate expressions on HellStory counter

g.title: j3788948842->j617454213
g.text: RoatheFailNot21

g.title: j2338384480
g.text: A new day dawns, and I find myself planning for the future for the first time in... a long time. Thinking on how I could reshape this world around me. On how I could wield what I know. What I am. How I could make better use of it.

g.title: j4205868229
g.text: A new day dawns, and I find myself planning for the future for the first time in... a long time. Thinking on what this means for me, for what I want, for how I wish to reshape my environment to suit me.

g.title: j1521830949
g.text: May I ask precisely what it is you are waiting for? I sit here with my recollection of events still perfectly intact. You gave me your word that you would clear them from my mind.

g.title: j2304643196->j1521830949
g.text: RoatheWillReset

g.title: j3385732763
g.text: Have you made up your mind yet? I am a patient devil, but I have my limits. Will you wipe my mind clean of these memories, or do you wish to let me linger on?

g.title: j2304643196->j3385732763
g.text: RoatheFailStall

g.title: j2283197743
g.text: Here we are, and here we shall remain. In this Purgatory. I hope you enjoy it here, as I do not think we shall ever go a step farther.

g.title: j2304643196->j2283197743
g.text: false

g.title: j134617919
g.text: What do you mean?

g.title: j2168037976
g.text: A little from column A, a little from column B?

g.title: j1326913798
g.text: None of this is about you, Roathe. It never has been.

g.title: j3401265586
g.text: You fool! What have you done?! Why, why go and delve into caverns where you are not welcome?!

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j617454213->Chat ends.
g.text: false

g.title: j3984658869
g.text: Check boolean RoatheDating

g.title: j2558396776
g.text: Check boolean RoatheDating

g.title: j3556672345
g.text: I know. But these things take time, and we need to wait.

g.title: j1942198326
g.text: I changed my mind. I'm sorry.

g.title: j2332710454
g.text: I will. I'm getting there. I promise.

g.title: j684607746
g.text: No. I can't do this. I'm sorry. I can't do this to you.

g.title: j703203293
g.text: Fine. I give in. I'll do what you want.

g.title: j2171950327
g.text: Check boolean LoidFamilyComplete

g.title: j3992815676
g.text: Whatever you seek from me, you shall not have it now. You might as well be done with it and wipe my memory clean of this travesty of ours.

g.title: j2417391013
g.text: Well, whatever you seek from me, you shall not have it now. You might as well be done with it and wipe my memory clean of this travesty of ours.

g.title: j2141906348
g.text: That is quite clear, you needn't worry.

g.title: j4285424905
g.text: I demand you fix this. This is your fault. I can feel it, clawing at me, tearing at me. Like some great beast.

g.title: j3974734044
g.text: It would be poor form to not acknowledge that this is due to your help, darling. Thank you.

g.title: j3984658869->j3974734044
g.text: true

g.title: j1415211089
g.text: It would be poor form to not acknowledge that this is due to your help, Usurper. Thank you.

g.title: j3984658869->j1415211089
g.text: false

g.title: j3838177785
g.text: It would be poor form to not acknowledge that this is due largely to your help, darling.

g.title: j2558396776->j3838177785
g.text: true

g.title: j87369137
g.text: It would be poor form to not acknowledge that this is due largely to your help, Usurper.

g.title: j2558396776->j87369137
g.text: false

g.title: j325588956
g.text: Mm. Very well. I am a patient devil, but the waters of that well can be exhausted over time, trust me.

g.title: j1226837478
g.text: I see. As simple as that, is it?

g.title: j279253026
g.text: Mm. See that you do. I am a patient devil, but the waters of that well can be exhausted over time, trust me.

g.title: j1991436428
g.text: Even if it means we are trapped forever in this impasse? You poor, sad Usurper... very well. Purgatory is an improvement over Hell for a devil, is it not?

g.title: j2921449333
g.text: Good. Get to it. I tire of living with this knowledge in my skull.

g.title: j310929033
g.text: Though, what does it matter to you? You have all that you wish to cut from my empty corpse. My ribs are bare and bleached.

g.title: j2171950327->j310929033
g.text: true

g.title: j122138272
g.text: Tragic, isn't it? Knowing that the dregs of Entrati's family will never know that the butler moulders down here, wringing his hands in grief? All alone?

g.title: j2171950327->j122138272
g.text: false

g.title: j1478268251
g.text: It will be the only way forward for you, if that is what you seek. If you care not, then I care not. Do what you will.

g.title: j1868770690
g.text: Rid me of this. Rid me of this plague. Clear my mind of these memories. I know you can. Use this gift that you have and end it all. Now.

g.title: j823125180
g.text: I couldn't leave you chasing that pointy tail of yours forever.

g.title: j2833478379
g.text: You're welcome.

g.title: j693488537
g.text: I couldn't leave you chasing that pointy tail of yours forever. It was going to get sad.

g.title: j3561873533
g.text: You're welcome.

g.title: j741140548
g.text: Largely? If it weren't for me, you'd still be stuck chasing that pointy tail of yours, Roathe.

g.title: j240549449
g.text: You're welcome.

g.title: j384744226
g.text: Largely? If it weren't for me, you'd still be stuck chasing that pointy tail of yours, Roathe.

g.title: j2000954999
g.text: You're welcome.

g.title: j431793363
g.text: Boolean RoatheFailUltimate is now true.

g.title: j3531477191
g.text: I do not know whom the zealots will be more disappointed at; you or I.

g.title: j378811769
g.text: Add 1 to Promise counter

g.title: j1776100240
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j1063490160
g.text: And do not concern yourself with bothering the zealots to whine in my ear hoping to convince me to show you mercy. It will not work.

g.title: j2117701808
g.text: Those are a different kind of memory, Roathe. It won't work on them. They are buried deeper in your psyche.

g.title: j1088756539
g.text: Running and hiding from the truth won't work. We'll just wind up right back where we started.

g.title: j717799577
g.text: Are you sure? But... you're smart, I get the feeling you'll figure something is up.

g.title: j220025886
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2665556245
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j140282531
g.text: How... quaint.

g.title: j578416406
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j14367642
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j837377030
g.text: Mm. Yes. Well.

g.title: j2781435904
g.text: Do not push your luck, Usurper.

g.text: Boolean RoatheNoDate is now true.

g.text: You can also say farewell to our other contract.

g.title: j3678452504
g.text: I was rather looking forward to watching him shake in terror as he crawled up those stairs in shame.

g.title: j1776100240->j3678452504
g.text: RoatheDeal

g.title: j1859217847
g.text: But what does it matter to you?

g.title: j1776100240->j1859217847
g.text: false

g.title: j3608727997
g.text: That may be. You are very likely right. But I do not have any other options to try, now do I? It is worth the attempt.

g.title: j239267210
g.text: And if that is the case, then you can simply do the deed again. It is like you have an inexhaustible gift, isn't it?

g.title: j3470693998
g.text: Very likely. I will put two and two together and blame you for doing something I did not ask you to do. I am sure you will weather the storm.

g.title: j2774110276
g.text: Mm, yes, well. I know how much you enjoy this "pointy tail" of mine.

g.title: j4120864970
g.text: I simply wished to express my gratitude. Not linger on it.

g.text: Now that we have that done, I believe we have something else to discuss, do we not?

g.title: j2665556245->j4215254519
g.text: false

g.title: j1311246052
g.text: Check boolean RoatheDating

g.title: j2989953447
g.text: Boolean RoatheFailStall is now false.

g.title: j2555690150
g.text: Typical.

g.title: j3586966234
g.text: Wait. Why?!

g.title: j1641034512
g.text: You said you'd help if I helped you recovered your memories. And I did. That was our contract!

g.title: j1667380365
g.text: Wait. Why won't you help me?

g.title: j4142729549
g.text: Naught.

g.title: j1352697846
g.text: I am certain I will be hideously angry at you once I realize you have altered my memories, of course. And I recommend not telling me it was by my request, darling.

g.title: j4081414586
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1466456391
g.text: Check boolean RoatheKnowsReset2

g.title: j1311246052->j2417391013
g.text: false

g.text: Boolean IsDating is now false.

g.title: j1311246052->j1853401555

g.title: j1613865946
g.text: Don't be so bitter, just because you realize now that you have been outplayed. I offered you the terms of the contract without ever spelling out my end of things. Or did you fail to notice?

g.title: j168600879
g.text: I offered you the terms of the contract without ever spelling out my end of things. Or did you fail to notice?

g.title: j874842218
g.text: "I am in need of someone to help me record my memories and assist me in reconciling them. A temporary assistant of sorts."

g.title: j2233209589
g.text: I will simply claim you are lying, and it will likely damage my opinion of you beyond repair.

g.title: j3058105942
g.text: Each time we speak I cannot help but wonder if the shores we tread are familiar or foreign to you. If I am merely repeating myself, or if I hold some new surprise.

g.title: j1466456391->j3058105942
g.text: true

g.title: j1238002096
g.text: You upheld your end of our contract. We have now come to the penultimate point where we must arrange the particulars of how we will lay out our method of attack.

g.title: j1466456391->j1238002096
g.text: false

g.title: j2302720709
g.text: Boolean RoatheDating is now false.

g.title: j1703196075
g.text: I simply said what you would have out of the arrangement. I never said what you had to do, or why, to get them. And you blindly agreed.

g.title: j3679445998
g.text: While you met the first criteria, "recording my memories," you failed spectacularly at the latter, "assist me in reconciling them."

g.title: j3971392255
g.text: No. I can't do this. I won't do this. We have to face down this situation together. Can't we just talk about this?

g.title: j1296988595
g.text: I... there's really no other way?

g.title: j677388715
g.text: Either way, I rather you not tell me. I hate when I am too overtly predictable. Regardless, you have helped me resolve a matter keenly important to my own self.

g.title: j2216158498
g.text: This battle must be waged on three fronts. All must work in concert for this war to be won.

g.title: j2553799106
g.text: Well, whatever you seek from me, you shall not have it now. You might as well be done with it and wipe my memory clean of this travesty of ours, "Drifter darling."

g.title: j337280456
g.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.

g.title: j624933318
g.text: I would hardly say they are reconciled, would you?

g.title: j4280899041
g.text: No. If you want the butler to go upstairs? You wipe my mind of all of this nonsense as I have asked. If you do not care? Then do as you wish. It matters not to me.

g.title: j2486388606
g.text: I slept better last night than I have in so very long. I would say "longer than I can remember," but that would be a joke in very poor taste.

g.title: j985782477
g.text: Pardon me?

g.title: j4002654295
g.text: Are we talking about Loid?

g.title: j1636362832
g.text: It will be the only way forward for you, if that is what you seek. If you care not, then I care not. Do what you will.

g.title: j4138167829
g.text: Is there any way I could change your mind?

g.title: j3786792666
g.text: How do I get out of this?

g.title: j1887575000
g.text: You did not meet your end of the bargain, so I shall not meet mine.

g.title: j2092497863
g.text: That, and, well, of course, our personal friendship is the only leverage I own in this situation. It is that simple.

g.title: j1667133062
g.text: И в свою очередь я теперь помогу тебе. Этот дворецкий. Ты все ещё хочешь вернуть его к семье Альбрехта наверху?

g.title: j402779149
g.text: Дворецкий. Его возвращение к семье Альбрехта. Ты всё ещё хочешь этого, верно?

g.title: j2638501927
g.text: Да. Постарайся не отставать. Я полагаю, ты всё ещё хочешь вернуть его к семье Альбрехта наверху, да?

g.title: j2100574820
g.text: И не пытайся подсылать ко мне ревнителей веры, чтобы они канючили у меня под боком, вымаливая тебе милость. Ничего у них не выйдет.

g.title: j614519319
g.text: No. And I am no longer in the mood to assist you in such matters.

g.title: j3409579212
g.text: The same way you found yourself mired in it in the first place.

g.title: j1414284106
g.text: Есть ли хоть малейший шанс, что я смогу переубедить тебя?

g.title: j196311977
g.text: Как мне из этого выбраться?

g.title: j601506214
g.text: What say you?

g.title: j744968765
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j1949841813
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j136786926
g.text: Или, возможно, нужна новая методика. Я не здесь для того, чтобы помогать тебе в таких делах.

g.title: j1463039195
g.text: Нет. И у меня больше нет ни малейшего желания помогать тебе в подобном.

g.title: j434957283
g.text: Думаю, ты знаешь как. Но если память тебе изменила, позволь напомнить тебе... как там звучала эта фраза?

g.title: j4032046539
g.text: Ладно. Я... я сделаю это. Я сотру твою память. Даже если вместе с этим исчезнут воспоминания о Мари и Лионе.

g.title: j390831430
g.text: Нет. Я отказываюсь. Я найду иной путь, чтобы убедить тебя продолжить свой путь.

g.title: j678122280
g.text: Нет, всё нормально. Для меня это не имеет большого значения.

g.text: От всей души желаю тебе удачи.

g.title: j1773271505
g.text: Тобою было сделано так много, проделан такой путь, и теперь вдруг решаешь, что...

g.title: j1028374098
g.text: Хорошая работа с привлечением поддержки фанатиков. Мари и Лион будут бесценны, как бы ни не хотелось это признавать.

g.title: j2724845416

g.title: j2047351097
g.text: Путь будет расчищен, и всё встанет на свои места. В ближайшие дни ожидаются разговоры с фанатиками. Ах. И помнится?

g.title: j1931379847
